We develop computational tools for single-cell, spatial, and multi-omics data analysis. This page collects lab software, packages, analysis code, and related publications.

## Φ-Space

- Related paper: **Mao, J.**, Deng, Y. & Lê Cao, K.-A. (2024). Φ-Space: Continuous phenotyping of single-cell multi-omics data. *Genome Biology*.

## Φ-Space ST

A platform-agnostic method to identify cell states in spatial transcriptomics studies.

- Related paper: **Mao, J.**, Choi, J. & Lê Cao, K.-A. (2026). Φ-Space ST. *Cell Reports Methods*.
- Seminar recording: <https://mixomics.org/2025/02/webinar-%cf%86-space-st-a-platform-agnostic-method-to-identify-cell-states-in-spatial-transcriptomics-studies/>
- Software link: Placeholder.

## NeighbourNet

Scalable cell-specific coexpression networks for granular regulatory pattern discovery.

- Related paper: Deng, Y., **Mao, J.**, Choi, J. & Lê Cao, K.-A. (2026). *Genome Research*.
- Software link: Placeholder.

## phylobar

An R package for multiresolution compositional barplots in omics studies.

- Related paper: Kuo, M., Lê Cao, K.-A., Kodikara, S., **Mao, J.**, Sankaran, K. (2025). *Bioinformatics*.
- Software link: Placeholder.

## CellDiffusion

A generative model to annotate single-cell and spatial RNA-seq using bulk references.

- Related paper: Zhang, X., **Mao, J.** & Lê Cao, K.-A. (2025). *bioRxiv*.
- Software link: Placeholder.
